biggest_catch: The referred friend must be a Kansas resident who opens their first CUA Core Checking Account with a minimum initial deposit of $100 and keeps it for at least 30 days; if any of that fails, you get nothing - and your lifetime cap is 10 referrals / $500.
catches: Referred friend must be age 18 or older, open their FIRST CUA Core Checking Account with a minimum initial deposit of $100 for at least 30 days, present a valid referral code at account opening, and be a Kansas resident.
Credit Union of America employees and volunteers are not eligible.
Lifetime cap: $500 per member (ten $50 bonuses); you can refer unlimited people but only get paid ten times.
Bonus deposited within 60 days of the referred checking account opening.
Bonuses may be reportable to the recipient and IRS; fees may reduce earnings.
